title: Robert Bechtle (1932-2020)
content: Robert Bechtle(1932-2020), one of the champions of Photrealism, once said: "One reason my paintings have become realistic has to do with my interest in what things really look like."Robert Bechtle: A RetrospectiveBeyond his way of interpreting reality in photographic terms, his work is striking for its inclusion of mundane subjects.
